passages.text: Then David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest. And when Ahimelech met David, he trembled and asked him, “Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?”
passages.sermon:
David was a servant of King Saul.
David traveled to Nob.
Nob was a city where priests lived.
Ahimelech was a priest in Nob.
David came to Ahimelech.
Ahimelech saw David arrive.
Ahimelech became afraid when he saw David.
Ahimelech went out to meet David.
Ahimelech asked David a question.
Ahimelech said, “Why are you alone?”
Ahimelech also said, “Why is no one with you?”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א דָוִד֙ נֹ֔בֶה אֶל־ אֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיֶּחֱרַ֨ד אֲחִימֶ֜לֶךְ לִקְרַ֣את דָּוִ֗ד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מַדּ֤וּעַ אַתָּה֙ לְבַדֶּ֔ךָ וְאִ֖ישׁ אֵ֥ין אִתָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: “The king has given me a mission,” David replied. “He told me no one is to know about the mission or charge. And I have directed my young men to meet me at a certain place.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to Ahimelech the priest.
David said, “The king has given me a mission.
He told me something important.
He said, ‘No one must know anything about the matter I am sending you to do.
No one must know about the command I have given you.’
I have told my young men to go to a certain place.
They are waiting for me there.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לַאֲחִימֶ֣לֶךְ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן הַמֶּלֶךְ֮ צִוַּ֣נִי דָבָר֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י אִ֣ישׁ אַל־ יֵ֧דַע מְא֛וּמָה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵֽחֲךָ֖ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑ךָ וְאֶת־ הַנְּעָרִ֣ים יוֹדַ֔עְתִּי אֶל־ מְק֥וֹם פְּלֹנִ֖י אַלְמוֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever can be found.”
passages.sermon:
David spoke to Ahimelech the priest.
David asked for food.
David said, “What do you have here?”
David said, “Give me five loaves of bread.”
David said, “Or give me whatever you can find.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה מַה־ יֵּ֧שׁ תַּֽחַת־ יָדְךָ֛ חֲמִשָּׁה־ לֶ֖חֶם תְּנָ֣ה בְיָדִ֑י א֖וֹ הַנִּמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: “There is no common bread on hand,” the priest replied, “but there is some consecrated bread—provided that the young men have kept themselves from women.”
passages.sermon:
Ahimelech was a priest.
Ahimelech spoke to David.
Ahimelech said, “I do not have any ordinary bread here.”
He said, “I have only holy bread.”
He said, “I can give it if the young men have kept themselves from women.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַן הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־ דָּוִד֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר אֵֽין־ לֶ֥חֶם חֹ֖ל אֶל־ תַּ֣חַת יָדִ֑י כִּֽי־ אִם־ לֶ֤חֶם קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יֵ֔שׁ אִם־ נִשְׁמְר֥וּ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים אַ֥ךְ מֵאִשָּֽׁה׃פ

passages.text: David answered, “Women have indeed been kept from us, as is usual when I set out. And the equipment of the young men is holy, as it is even on common missions, and all the more at this time.”
passages.sermon:
David spoke to the priest.
David said, “We have not been with women.
This is always true when I leave on a journey.
The young men’s things are holy.
This is true even on ordinary missions.
Today, the things are even more holy.”
passages.original: וַיַּעַן֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת־ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־ אִשָּׁ֤ה עֲצֻֽרָה־ לָ֙נוּ֙ כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם בְּצֵאתִ֕י וַיִּהְי֥וּ כְלֵֽי־ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְהוּא֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ חֹ֔ל וְאַ֕ף כִּ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם יִקְדַּ֥שׁ בַּכֶּֽלִי׃

passages.text: So the priest gave him the consecrated bread, since there was no bread there but the Bread of the Presence, which had been removed from before the LORD and replaced with hot bread on the day it was taken away.
passages.sermon:
The priest gave David consecrated bread.
There was no other bread there.
Only the Bread of the Presence was available.
This bread had been removed from before the LORD.
They replaced it with hot bread on the day they took it away.
passages.original: וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן קֹ֑דֶשׁ כִּי֩ לֹא־ הָ֨יָה שָׁ֜ם לֶ֗חֶם כִּֽי־ אִם־ לֶ֤חֶם הַפָּנִים֙ הַמּֽוּסָרִים֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לָשׂוּם֙ לֶ֣חֶם חֹ֔ם בְּי֖וֹם הִלָּקְחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained before the LORD. And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul.
passages.sermon:
Doeg was a servant of Saul.
Doeg was present that day.
The Lord detained Doeg there.
Doeg was an Edomite.
Doeg was the chief shepherd for Saul.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֡ם אִישׁ֩ מֵעַבְדֵ֨י שָׁא֜וּל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נֶעְצָר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּשְׁמ֖וֹ דֹּאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִ֑י אַבִּ֥יר הָרֹעִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְשָׁאֽוּל׃

passages.text: Then David asked Ahimelech, “Is there not a spear or sword on hand here? For I have brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business was urgent.”
passages.sermon:
David spoke to Ahimelech.
David asked Ahimelech a question.
David said, “Is there a spear here?
Is there a sword here?
Do you have any weapon here with you?”
David explained why he needed a weapon.
David said, “I did not bring my sword.
I did not bring my weapons.
The king’s business was urgent.
I left quickly.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ לַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְאִ֛ין יֶשׁ־ פֹּ֥ה תַֽחַת־ יָדְךָ֖ חֲנִ֣ית אוֹ־ חָ֑רֶב כִּ֣י גַם־ חַרְבִּ֤י וְגַם־ כֵּלַי֙ לֹֽא־ לָקַ֣חְתִּי בְיָדִ֔י כִּֽי־ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ נָחֽוּץ׃ס

passages.text: The priest replied, “The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want, you may take it. For there is no other but this one.” And David said, “There is none like it; give it to me.”
passages.sermon:
Ahimelech was a priest.
He spoke to David.
He said, “The sword of Goliath is here.”
Goliath was a Philistine.
David killed Goliath in the Valley of Elah.
The sword is wrapped in a cloth.
It is behind the ephod.
If you want to take it, you may take it.
There is no other sword here except this one.”
David answered.
He said, “There is none like it.
Give it to me.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן חֶרֶב֩ גָּלְיָ֨ת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֜י אֲשֶׁר־ הִכִּ֣יתָ׀ בְּעֵ֣מֶק הָאֵלָ֗ה הִנֵּה־ הִ֞יא לוּטָ֣ה בַשִּׂמְלָה֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאֵפוֹד֒ אִם־ אֹתָ֤הּ תִּֽקַּח־ לְךָ֙ קָ֔ח כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין אַחֶ֛רֶת זוּלָתָ֖הּ בָּזֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֵ֥ין כָּמ֖וֹהָ תְּנֶ֥נָּה לִּֽי׃

passages.text: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.
passages.sermon:
David was a servant of King Saul.
Saul wanted to harm David.
David became afraid of Saul.
On that day, David got up.
David ran away from Saul.
David went to Achish.
Achish was the king of Gath.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֔ד וַיִּבְרַ֥ח בַּיּוֹם־ הַה֖וּא מִפְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַיָּבֹ֕א אֶל־ אָכִ֖ישׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ גַּֽת׃

passages.text: But the servants of Achish said to him, “Is this not David, the king of the land? Did they not sing about him in their dances, saying: ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”
passages.sermon:
The servants of Achish spoke to Achish.
They said, "This is David."
David is the king of the land.
People sang about David in their dances.
They said, "Saul has killed his thousands."
They said, "David has killed his tens of thousands."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ עַבְדֵ֤י אָכִישׁ֙ אֵלָ֔יו הֲלוֹא־ זֶ֥ה דָוִ֖ד מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאָ֑רֶץ הֲל֣וֹא לָזֶ֗ה יַעֲנ֤וּ בַמְּחֹלוֹת֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ בְּאַלְפּוֹ וְדָוִ֖ד בְּרִבְבֹתוֹ׃

passages.text: Now David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
passages.sermon:
David heard the words of Achish’s servants.
David thought about these words deeply.
David became very afraid.
David feared Achish, the king of Gath.
passages.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה בִּלְבָב֑וֹ וַיִּרָ֣א מְאֹ֔ד מִפְּנֵ֖י אָכִ֥ישׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ גַּֽת׃

passages.text: So he changed his behavior before them and feigned madness in their hands; he scratched on the doors of the gate and let his saliva run down his beard.
passages.sermon:
David was in the city of Gath.
David stood before the servants of Achish, king of Gath.
David changed his behavior in front of them.
David pretended to be insane while they watched him.
David scratched marks on the doors of the city gate.
David let his saliva run down onto his beard.
passages.original: וַיְשַׁנּ֤וֹ אֶת־ טַעְמוֹ֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּתְהֹלֵ֖ל בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיְתַו עַל־ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔עַר וַיּ֥וֹרֶד רִיר֖וֹ אֶל־ זְקָנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you can see that the man is insane! Why have you brought him to me?
passages.sermon:
Achish was the king of Gath.
Achish spoke to his servants.
Achish said, "Look at this man."
"You see that he is acting insane."
"Why did you bring him to me?"
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אָכִ֖ישׁ אֶל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו הִנֵּ֤ה תִרְאוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּ֔עַ לָ֛מָּה תָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: Am I in need of madmen, that you have brought this man to rave in my presence? Must this man come into my house?”
passages.sermon:
Achish was the king of Gath.
Achish spoke to his servants.
Achish saw David acting like a madman.
Achish said, “I do not need more madmen.
You have brought this man to act insane in front of me.
Should this man come into my house?”
passages.original: חֲסַ֤ר מְשֻׁגָּעִים֙ אָ֔נִי כִּי־ הֲבֵאתֶ֣ם אֶת־ זֶ֔ה לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּ֖עַ עָלָ֑י הֲזֶ֖ה יָב֥וֹא אֶל־ בֵּיתִֽי׃ס
